rationale: The core DE handling matches the reference: no DESeq()/Wald test, no gene-level p-values or shrinkage, median-of-ratios size factors computed inside DESeq2, explicit reference level and contrast, a minimal justified filter, and a report that names the missing replication and the design that would support inference. The plan departs from the reference by running preranked fgsea across four collections on a 1-vs-1 descriptive log2FC and reporting fgsea nominal/BH-adjusted p-values; enrichment is not warranted here and the reference produces no p-values at all, so the hypothesis-generating framing only partly mitigates this. QC lists the right elements but with two samples there is no real outlier/shallow-sample policy beyond noting the limitation.
